name: Pratyaksh Hanstantrit Labh / Direct Benefits Transfer For LPG
benefit: - **Direct Subsidy Transfer:** LPG consumers receive subsidies directly in their bank accounts automatically.  - **Improved Availability:** Enhanced market availability of new LPG connections for genuine consumers.  - **Health Benefits:** Replaces unclean cooking fuels, reducing indoor pollution and preventing respiratory diseases among women and children in rural areas.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant must be an LPG user.
- The combined taxable income of the applicant and their spouse should not exceed ₹10,00,000 in the previous financial year, as per the Income Tax Act, 1961.
